entries.name: /help
entries.description: Show available commands and usage hints inside Claude Code.

entries.name: /clear
entries.description: Clear the conversation and start fresh, preserving instructions from CLAUDE.md.

entries.name: /model
entries.description: Select or change the AI model. Use left/right arrows or +/- to adjust effort on supported models.

entries.name: /compact
entries.description: Compress conversation history to free context window space, optionally passing custom summarization instructions.

entries.name: /cost
entries.description: Show token usage and cost for the current session. Alias for /usage.

entries.name: /permissions
entries.description: View and manage tool permissions for the current session.

entries.name: /config
entries.description: Open interactive settings menu to configure Claude Code preferences.

entries.name: /resume
entries.description: Resume a conversation by ID or name, or open the session picker.

entries.name: /memory
entries.description: Edit CLAUDE.md memory files and enable or disable auto-memory for the project.

entries.name: /rename
entries.description: Rename the current session and show the name on the prompt bar.

entries.name: /agents
entries.description: Manage agent configurations for the current session.

entries.name: /add-dir
entries.description: Add additional working directories for file access within this session.

entries.name: /desktop
entries.description: Continue the current session in the Claude Code Desktop app (macOS and Windows only).

entries.name: /init
entries.description: Generate a CLAUDE.md file documenting your project structure and conventions.

entries.name: /upgrade
entries.description: Open the upgrade page to switch to a higher plan tier.

entries.name: /login
entries.description: Sign in to your Claude account.

entries.name: /logout
entries.description: Sign out from your Claude account.

entries.name: /status
entries.description: Open Settings interface (Status tab) showing version, model, account, and connection status.

entries.name: /mcp
entries.description: Manage Model Context Protocol servers connected to Claude Code.

entries.name: /review
entries.description: Review a pull request locally in the current session.

entries.name: /hooks
entries.description: View hook configurations for tool events.

entries.name: /keybindings
entries.description: Open or create keyboard shortcuts configuration file.

entries.name: /doctor
entries.description: Run diagnostics to identify configuration issues and suggest fixes.

entries.name: /voice
entries.description: Enable or configure voice dictation mode.

entries.name: /exit
entries.description: Exit Claude Code session.

entries.name: /effort
entries.description: Set the model effort level for the current session (low, medium, high, xhigh) or auto.

entries.name: /plan
entries.description: Enter plan mode before a large change, optionally with a task description.

entries.name: /background
entries.description: Detach the current session to run as a background agent, freeing your terminal.

entries.name: /tasks
entries.description: List and manage background tasks running in the current session.

entries.name: /rewind
entries.description: Rewind the conversation and/or code to a previous checkpoint.

entries.name: /diff
entries.description: Open an interactive diff viewer showing uncommitted changes.

entries.name: /batch
entries.description: (Skill) Orchestrate large-scale codebase changes in parallel by decomposing work into independent units, each in an isolated git worktree.
entries.example: /batch migrate src/ from Solid to React

entries.name: /simplify
entries.description: (Skill) Review recently changed files and apply quality and efficiency fixes.

entries.name: /context
entries.description: Visualize current context window usage as a colored grid with optimization hints.

entries.name: /fast
entries.description: Toggle fast mode on or off.

entries.name: /plugin
entries.description: Manage Claude Code plugins (browse, install, remove).

entries.name: /skills
entries.description: List available skills and manage their visibility.

entries.name: claude
entries.description: Start an interactive Claude Code session, optionally with an initial prompt.

entries.name: claude -p
entries.description: Run a one-off query in non-interactive print mode and exit.

entries.name: claude -c / --continue
entries.description: Resume the most recent conversation in the current directory.

entries.name: claude --resume
entries.description: Resume a specific session by ID or name.

entries.name: claude --model
entries.description: Override the model for this session (opus, sonnet, haiku, or full model ID).

entries.name: claude --effort
entries.description: Set the effort level for this session (low, medium, high, xhigh, max).

entries.name: claude -w / --worktree
entries.description: Start Claude in an isolated git worktree. If no name is given, one is auto-generated.

entries.name: claude -n / --name
entries.description: Set a display name for the session.

entries.name: claude --add-dir
entries.description: Grant file access to additional working directories.

entries.name: claude --permission-mode
entries.description: Start in a specific permission mode (default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions).

entries.name: claude --debug
entries.description: Enable debug logging for troubleshooting.

entries.name: claude auth login
entries.description: Sign in to Claude account or Anthropic Console.

entries.name: claude auth logout
entries.description: Sign out from Claude account.

entries.name: claude auth status
entries.description: Check current authentication status.

entries.name: claude update
entries.description: Update Claude Code to the latest version.

entries.name: claude mcp
entries.description: Configure Model Context Protocol servers.

entries.name: claude plugin
entries.description: Manage Claude Code plugins.

entries.name: claude agents
entries.description: Open agent view to monitor and dispatch parallel background sessions.

entries.name: claude remote-control
entries.description: Start Remote Control server for controlling Claude Code from claude.ai.

entries.name: claude --version
entries.description: Display the installed Claude Code version.

entries.name: claude attach
entries.description: Attach to a background session in the current terminal.

entries.name: claude stop
entries.description: Stop a background session.

entries.name: claude --output-format
entries.description: Specify output format for print mode (text, json, stream-json).

entries.name: claude --max-turns
entries.description: Limit the number of agentic turns in print mode. Exits with an error if the limit is reached.

entries.name: / (focus prompt)
entries.description: When a slash command list is open, '/' filters it. In this cheat sheet, '/' focuses the search bar from anywhere on the page.

entries.name: Enter
entries.description: Submit a message or prompt to Claude.

entries.name: Escape
entries.description: Cancel current input or close menus.

entries.name: Ctrl+C
entries.description: Interrupt and cancel the current operation.

entries.name: Ctrl+D
entries.description: Exit Claude Code.

entries.name: Ctrl+R
entries.description: Open history search to find and re-run previous prompts.

entries.name: Ctrl+L
entries.description: Force a full screen redraw, preserving input. In fullscreen mode, press twice within two seconds to run /clear.

entries.name: Ctrl+T
entries.description: Toggle task list visibility.

entries.name: Ctrl+O
entries.description: Toggle verbose transcript view showing reasoning and internal steps.

entries.name: Shift+Tab
entries.description: Cycle through permission modes (default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions).

entries.name: Ctrl+G / Ctrl+X Ctrl+E
entries.description: Open message in external editor.

entries.name: Ctrl+J
entries.description: Insert a newline without submitting.

entries.name: Ctrl+S
entries.description: Stash current prompt to save it for later.

entries.name: Option+T / Alt+T
entries.description: Toggle extended thinking mode on or off.

entries.name: Cmd+P / Ctrl+P (Windows/Linux)
entries.description: Open model picker to switch models or adjust effort.

entries.name: Ctrl+X Ctrl+K
entries.description: Kill all background agents.

entries.name: SessionStart
entries.description: Runs when a session begins or resumes.

entries.name: Setup
entries.description: Runs one-time preparation in CI or scripts with --init-only, --init, or --maintenance.

entries.name: SessionEnd
entries.description: Runs when a session terminates.

entries.name: UserPromptSubmit
entries.description: Runs before Claude processes a user prompt.

entries.name: Stop
entries.description: Runs when Claude finishes responding.

entries.name: PreToolUse
entries.description: Runs before a tool call executes; can block or modify the call.

entries.name: PostToolUse
entries.description: Runs after a tool call succeeds.

entries.name: PermissionRequest
entries.description: Runs when a permission dialog appears.

entries.name: SubagentStart
entries.description: Runs when a subagent is spawned.

entries.name: SubagentStop
entries.description: Runs when a subagent finishes.

entries.name: InstructionsLoaded
entries.description: Runs when CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules files are loaded.

entries.name: type: command
entries.description: Run a shell command with JSON input on stdin.

entries.name: type: http
entries.description: Send a JSON POST request to a URL endpoint.

entries.name: type: prompt
entries.description: Send a prompt to Claude for single-turn evaluation.

entries.name: type: agent
entries.description: Spawn a subagent that can use tools to verify conditions.

entries.name: PostToolUseFailure
entries.description: Runs after a tool call fails.

entries.name: PreCompact
entries.description: Runs before context compaction.

entries.name: PostCompact
entries.description: Runs after context compaction completes.

entries.name: type: mcp_tool
entries.description: Call a tool on an already-connected MCP server; the tool's text output is treated like command-hook stdout.

entries.name: claude mcp add
entries.description: Add a new MCP server to the project configuration.

entries.name: claude mcp list
entries.description: List all configured MCP servers.

entries.name: claude mcp remove
entries.description: Remove an MCP server from the project configuration.

entries.name: Transport: stdio
entries.description: MCP server that runs as a subprocess with stdin/stdout communication.

entries.name: Transport: SSE
entries.description: Server-Sent Events transport for HTTP-based MCP servers.

entries.name: Transport: HTTP
entries.description: HTTP transport for MCP servers with request/response protocol.

entries.name: MCP Server: Filesystem
entries.description: Built-in MCP server for reading and writing files.

entries.name: MCP Server: GitHub
entries.description: Built-in MCP server for GitHub API integration.

entries.name: Explore
entries.description: Read-only agent for research and codebase exploration with Glob, Grep, and Read tools.

entries.name: Plan
entries.description: Planning-focused agent for creating implementation plans and specifications.

entries.name: general-purpose
entries.description: Default agent with full tool access for implementation tasks.

entries.name: description field
entries.description: Text describing when Claude should delegate tasks to this subagent.

entries.name: model field
entries.description: Specify which model the subagent should use.

entries.name: tools field
entries.description: Restrict which tools the subagent can access.

entries.name: skills field
entries.description: Preload specific skills into the subagent context at startup.

entries.name: isolation field
entries.description: Run the subagent in a temporary git worktree, giving it an isolated copy of the repository.

entries.name: permissionMode field
entries.description: Permission mode for the subagent (default, acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions, plan).

entries.name: Invoke directly
entries.description: Type a slash followed by skill name to invoke it directly.

entries.name: Auto-invocation
entries.description: Claude automatically invokes skills when relevant to your conversation.

entries.name: Personal skills
entries.description: Skills available across all your projects.

entries.name: Project skills
entries.description: Skills available only in the current project.

entries.name: SKILL.md name
entries.description: Display name for the skill (becomes the slash command).

entries.name: SKILL.md description
entries.description: What the skill does and when Claude should use it.

entries.name: SKILL.md disable-model-invocation
entries.description: Prevent Claude from automatically invoking this skill.

entries.name: SKILL.md context
entries.description: Run the skill in an isolated subagent context.

entries.name: permissions.allow
entries.description: Array of permission rules to allow tool use without prompting.

entries.name: permissions.ask
entries.description: Array of permission rules requiring confirmation before tool use.

entries.name: permissions.deny
entries.description: Array of permission rules to deny tool use.

entries.name: model
entries.description: Default model to use for sessions (opus, sonnet, haiku).

entries.name: effortLevel
entries.description: Persist effort level across sessions (low, medium, high, xhigh).

entries.name: env
entries.description: Environment variables applied to every session.

entries.name: hooks
entries.description: Configure automation hooks for various lifecycle events.

entries.name: alwaysThinkingEnabled
entries.description: Enable extended thinking by default in sessions.

entries.name: permissions.defaultMode
entries.description: Default permission mode (default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions).

entries.name: tui
entries.description: Terminal UI renderer (default or fullscreen).

entries.name: editorMode
entries.description: Key binding mode for text input (normal or vim).

entries.name: autoUpdatesChannel
entries.description: Release channel for automatic updates (stable or latest).

entries.name: sandbox
entries.description: Enable bash sandboxing with optional filesystem and network restrictions (macOS, Linux, WSL2).

entries.name: autoMemoryEnabled
entries.description: Enable or disable automatic memory accumulation across sessions. Default: true.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
entries.description: API key for Anthropic API access.

entries.name: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS
entries.description: Override the extended thinking token budget.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY
entries.description: Disable automatic memory accumulation across sessions.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING
entries.description: Force-disable extended thinking.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE
entries.description: Enable minimal mode with simpler system prompt and no auto-discovery.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_MODEL
entries.description: Override the default model.

entries.name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
entries.description: Disable telemetry collection.

entries.name: API_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Set API request timeout in milliseconds.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL
entries.description: Set the effort level for all sessions (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or auto).
